title: nonmonoticSequenceException
body:
The error in the log happens (I think) during the first days of a sensor (I'm using Libre with MM2). It seems to be related to BT disconnections but I'm unsure of this.
The initial calibration was done earlier than Xdrip requested it although the menu "initial calibration" was already available. It had received more than 3 data points.
The error says:
NonMonotonicSequenceException: org.apache.commons.math3.exception.NonMonotonicSequenceException: points 0 and 1 are not strictly increasing. 
Then it follows the last reading timestamp and, surprisingly, it compares the last reading with itself, instead of the previous one, thus the error.
Since it started to get disconnections from BT in spite of being the collector on my side, I suspect it might alter the BT connection (in those cases, it yields the error "receiving too much data"). But I'm unsure on this. It only happens eventually and randomly.

I'm using the version 7d97b62-2019.09.30 since I saw no new improvement relevant to me and I this version works perfectly in my Android 6 with MM2 and Libre.

It's perhaps a minor issue, but it deserves the attention in case it may affect to calibrations or anything else. I'm not an expert.

Thanks!
